content:
Idleon and active gameplay
Read the rest if you've made it to w4 and obtained elite classes + the secret class.
Now that we've got all elite classes + mman, 5 of which can efficiently play actively, you might wonder which character to active on and what to do while active. 
.........
<:Maestro:857411367068500008> is only good for 
1) boss kills (the highest possible drop rate), 
2) crystal cooldown (allows other skillers to have higher skill levels & efficiency)
.........
<:Bubo:978007371920081036> (Bubonic conjurer) is good for:
1) money farm
2) alchemy progress (cranium cooking)
.........
<:beast:978007246879465582> <:berz:978007149907152926> best for: just dont
.........
<:king:861740855840342066> (divine knight)  is good for:
1) statue farming (crystals)
2) colosseum
3) obol fragments (crystals)
4) w1 dungeon
5) minibosses with orb
.........
<:sailingB4osrs:1053990934330736640> (Siege breaker) is good for:
1) 10k-20k plunderous mob kills (drop rate boost to all characters)
.........
<:sub6:836664038262833198> (Elemental sorcerer) is good for: 
1) common mob mats (greenstacking, vials and deathnote)
2) rare mob mats (glass shards, snowflakes, batteries, pearlers)
3) rare drops (frisbees, bags, recipes)
4) small family damage boost (wormhole kills bonus)
5) mob obols (pop obols)
6) family bonus from class levels (extra levels to all talents)
7) mob card farming ( especially if going for ruby )
.........
Requirements to active:
<:Maestro:857411367068500008> 1 hit mobs + high crystal chance
<:Bubo:978007371920081036> level 200 tenteyecle + high crit chance + maps with high number of mobs
<:king:861740855840342066>  high crystal chance (by far the easiest to setup) + maps with 1 or 2 platforms
<:sailingB4osrs:1053990934330736640> 1 hit mobs 
<:sub6:836664038262833198> as high as possible damage + multikill + almost all maps are good

content: Can someone help me understand why Bubo is good for money? I don 't see anything in their talents that would make them better than an ES.  Is it that only 'real' enemies drop money?

I think Bubo's respawn is better for massive amounts of mobs, and it has stable map-clearing abilities.
ES's Wormhole is at a disadvantage at later maps, and later maps give more money per kill.
So Bubo > ES for money making.

I don't think Multikill affects money without the 'Coins For Charon' star talent, either.
I could be wrong, but I haven't seen anyone mention Multikill affecting money gain. 

The 'Nickel Of Wisdom' and 'Mage Is Best' Alchemy bubbles are needed for money farming.
Other (non-Beginner) classes have similar bubbles, but Mage classes were determined better for money at some point. Been a while since I've seen discussion about it, so I don't remember exactly why.
